font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">13–20 February 2027</span><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">Pallastunturi, Finnish Lapland</span><br><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">Pallas Kiteweek is a full week of snowkiting, fell landscapes and good</span><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">company in one of the most beautiful parts of Finnish Lapland.</span><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">Everyone stays together at Lapland Hotels Pallas, just a short walk</span><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">from the launch area.</span><br><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">The accommodation package includes seven nights, breakfast, dinner and</span><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">use of the hotel facilities. Shorter stays can also be booked between</span><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">13 and 20 February, subject to availability.</span><br><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">The days follow the wind and the conditions. Participants snowkite</span><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">independently, while lessons, flexible instruction, mountain guidance</span><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">and rental equipment can be arranged separately in advance. Pallas</span><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">offers terrain for experienced riders, and beginners can join by</span><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">booking suitable instruction.</span><br><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">For the full event story, current prices, accommodation details,</span><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">equipment and lessons, travel information and FAQ, visit:</span><br><a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://www.pallaskiteweek.com/">https://www.pallaskiteweek.com/</a><br><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">BOOKING</span><br><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">The payment made with this reservation is a deposit 50€/person, not the full</span><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">event price. Please state the exact deposit amount and when/how the</span><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">remaining balance will be charged.</span><br><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">1. Select your actual arrival and departure dates.</span><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">2. Select the room type and the number of guests staying in the same room.</span><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">3. Add the names of the other guests, dietary requirements, pets and</span><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">any roommate wishes in the additional information field.</span><br><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">EQUIPMENT RENTAL AND INSTRUCTION</span><br><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">If you are interested in equipment rental or instruction, select the</span><br><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">relevant option during booking.
